scripts.deploy:clean: pm2 delete reviewboost || true; pgrep -f "next-server \(v14.2.35\)" | xargs -r kill -9 || true; fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.deploy:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production PADDLE_ENV=sandbox npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:prod: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production PADDLE_ENV=live npm run deploy
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:clean && rm -rf .next && npm run build && if pm2 describe reviewboost >/dev/null 2>&1; then pm2 restart reviewboost --update-env; else pm2 start npm --name reviewboost -- run start; fi
scripts.start:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production PADDLE_ENV=sandbox npm run start
scripts.start:prod: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production PADDLE_ENV=live npm run start
scripts.deploy:dev: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production PADDLE_ENV=sandbox APP_BASE_URL=https://dev.reviewboost.co.kr npm run build && (pm2 describe reviewboost-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 && pm2 restart reviewboost-dev --update-env || APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production PADDLE_ENV=sandbox APP_BASE_URL=https://dev.reviewboost.co.kr pm2 start npm --name reviewboost-dev -- run start:dev)
scripts.test: npm run test:billing-schema && npm run test:paddle-utils
